_what: Where every known body beyond Neptune (class TNO in tnos.csv) and Voyager 1 were on one date, for the distance page's map. Orbits are laid flat on the ecliptic: each body keeps its true distance from the Sun, in the direction of its longitude of perihelion plus its true anomaly. Built by scripts/build_positions.py.
_source: Bodies: JPL Small-Body Database elements (tnos.csv), carried to the date by two-body motion. Voyager 1: JPL Horizons.

tnos.units: tenths of an AU; Sun at the origin, x toward the vernal equinox

voyager_1.src: JPL Horizons API, target -31, heliocentric ecliptic J2000 vectors
